newsitem.title: FINLAND: SANTASALO-JOT TO UP SANTASALO SHR CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: SANTASALO-JOT TO UP SANTASALO SHR CAPITAL.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Santasalo-JOT said on Thursday it had decided to boost the share capital of its unit Santasalo by 22.5 million markka.
Its German partner SEW-Eurodrive would subscribe to 34 percent of the new shares in Santasalo, the company said in a statement.
SEW-Eurodrive share of Santasalo rose to 20 percent in April, Santasalo-JOT said in its 1996 annual report.

It said the industrial gear unit Santasalo would expand its product range with a series of medium industrial gears, with an aim to win a 10 percent market share in the segment by 2005. It would invest an initial 30 million markka in 1997-1998.

"By the year 2001, investments are expected to have risen to about 80 million markka, when the plant will employ about 70 people and the same amount in parts' procurement and sub-contracting," it said.
